skill.description: # WAGO PLC MCP Server Connects AI agents to WAGO controllers (CC100, PFC100/200/300, Edge Controller, WP400, TP600) through the native WDA REST API over HTTPS. Agents discover, read and monitor PLC parameters, run methods and use watchlists across a fleet. Read-only by default: writes, method calls and file uploads need an explicit opt-in, and reboot/factory-reset/firmware methods stay blocked. Every write and refusal lands in a tamper-evident audit log. - Repository: https://github.com/WagoAlex
